$comment: Options for the rest_api service. Keys map 1:1 to RestApiService.__init__ kwargs (spread by main.create_classes) — keep in lockstep with the constructor; tests/test_config.py enforces this. 'devices_manager' and 'supervisor' are injected by main through create_classes(arguments=...) and are deliberately absent: declaring either here would let a config entry collide with the injected value and fail instantiation with 'got multiple values'. Every scalar also accepts 'string' and 'null': Config validates this schema BEFORE resolving ${VAR}, and an interpolated value is always a str, or null when a whole-value token resolves empty. 'required' is deliberately absent for the same reason — a '${MOTRIX_API_PORT}' template would satisfy it and still arrive as null. No 'minimum' either: it would constrain only the integer branch and silently pass '-1'; range checks live in api/options.py.

host.$comment: Bind address, default 127.0.0.1. The API serves device data and site topology unauthenticated, so binding beyond loopback is opt-in and logs a warning. In a container set ${MOTRIX_API_HOST} to 0.0.0.0 — each container has its own loopback, so nginx cannot reach 127.0.0.1 inside the edge container; the port is still never published to the host.

port.$comment: Default 8000. 0 binds an ephemeral port, which is how the tests avoid collisions; read the real one back from RestApiService.bound_port.

root_path.$comment: ASGI root_path: the prefix a reverse proxy strips (e.g. "/api"), so /docs and /openapi.json emit correct URLs. It does not change the paths this app serves.

access_log.$comment: uvicorn's per-request access log. Off by default: a viewer polling once a second would turn the EMS log into an access log.

docs.$comment: Serve /docs and /openapi.json. Turning it off is the one knob that shrinks the introspection surface without moving the port.

shutdown_timeout_seconds.$comment: uvicorn's graceful-shutdown budget, deliberately below runtime.shutdown_timeout_seconds (default 10): uvicorn's own default is unbounded, and a keep-alive connection held open by the proxy would outlive the supervisor's grace period and be reported as a straggler.
